description: This file defines a PlaceholderState struct and methods for managing placeholders used in internationalization (i18n) within the application. It includes functionality to generate unique placeholder strings and track used placeholders based on input text.

classes.name: PlaceholderState
classes.description: A struct that maintains a counter and a set of used placeholders for generating unique placeholder tokens.

methods.name: NewPlaceholderState
methods.description: Constructor function that initializes a new PlaceholderState, populating the used set with placeholders found in the provided text.

methods.name: PlaceholderState.Next
methods.description: Method that generates a new unique placeholder string, ensuring it does not clash with previously used placeholders.
